method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 她将就着喝了根啤酒，把笔记本电脑和笔记本拿回桌上。
facts.anchor: She settles for a root beer and brings the laptop and notebook back to the table.

facts.fact: 她翻看语音备忘录，播放了名为“乔莱特·史密斯——科尔姆·泰林二表亲”的文件。
facts.anchor: she scans through more of the voice memos, coming to rest on a file titled Jolette Smith—Colm Tyring second cousin—and hits play.

facts.fact: 乔莱特说布伦达吸食可卡因、氯胺酮，后来沾上海洛因，情况急转直下。
facts.anchor: Cocaine, ketamine—little of everything. When she got into heroin that’s when things really went south.

facts.fact: 乔莱特说布伦达开始注射毒品时科尔姆大概六七岁。
facts.anchor: Maybe six or seven when Brenda started shooting up.

facts.fact: 乔莱特把科尔姆带了几天，直到布伦达来接走他。
facts.anchor: Kept Colm for a few days until she came to pick him up.

facts.fact: 乔莱特发现科尔姆身上有瘀伤，圣诞节时手臂上有明显的烟头烫伤，于是打电话给社会服务部门，他们一度把科尔姆带走。
facts.anchor: then at Christmas he had a cigarette burn on his arm, plain as day.

facts.fact: 布伦达后来戒毒、在加油站找到工作、按时赴约出庭，重新取得了抚养权。
facts.anchor: got herself cleaned up enough to get a job at a gas station and made all her appointed visits and court dates and managed to get custody back.

facts.fact: 布伦达威胁说，若乔莱特再插手她和科尔姆的事，就放火烧房子把她烧死在床上。
facts.anchor: Said if I ever came in between her and Colm again I’d have a fire at my house while I was asleep, and I’d burn up in my bed.

facts.fact: 布伦达在周末死亡，直到接下来的周二才有人查看科尔姆，他独自和母亲的尸体待了几天。
facts.anchor: she died sometime during the weekend, and no one came to check on Colm until the following Tuesday.
